title: Version 1.9577.43: Quota Billing System
description: Implemented quota-based billing system for more flexible usage-based pricing and resource management.

title: Week 14 Updates: Computer Use in CLI, Interactive Lessons
description: Claude Code Week 14 (March 30 - April 3, 2026) introduces computer use capabilities to the CLI, allowing Claude to open native apps, click through UI, test its own changes, and fix issues from the terminal. Also includes interactive lessons (/powerup), flicker-free rendering, MCP result-size overrides (up to 500K characters), and plugin executables added to PATH.

community_feedback.quote: The timing is hard to ignore: just ten days ago, Anthropic sent legal threats to OpenCode, forcing them to remove built-in Claude authentication because third-party tools were using Claude Code's internal APIs to access Opus at subscription rates instead of pay-per-token pricing.

title: Computer Use in CLI: Native App Automation
description: Following desktop app computer use, Claude Code CLI now supports opening native applications, UI interaction, self-testing of changes, and automated fixing from the terminal environment.

community_feedback.quote: accidentally shipping your source map to npm is the kind of mistake that sounds impossible until you remember that a lot of the codebase was probably written by the AI you are shipping

title: Copilot SDK Public Preview
description: GitHub Copilot SDK entered public preview, allowing developers to build custom integrations and extend Copilot capabilities.

title: Background Agents in Slack Integration
description: Cursor now supports launching Background Agents directly from Slack by mentioning @Cursor, enabling AI-powered workflows within team communication channels.

community_feedback.quote: Thirty minutes after the Cursor 3 announcement hit Hacker News, the top comment wasn't about a feature. It was a plea. 'I wish they'd keep the old philosophy of letting the developer drive and the agent assist,' one user wrote. 'I still want to _code_, not vibe my way through tickets.'

title: BugBot: Automatic PR Review Agent
description: BugBot provides automated pull request review capabilities, identifying issues and suggesting fixes before merge.

title: One-Click MCP Server Installation
description: Simplified installation process for MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers with a single click, reducing setup complexity for external tool integrations.

title: Jupyter Notebook Support
description: Added support for Jupyter Notebook files with enhanced editing and AI assistance capabilities for data science workflows.

title: Memories Feature: Context Persistence
description: Memories feature allows Cursor to remember important project context and user preferences across sessions for more personalized assistance.

title: Unified Request-Based Pricing Model
description: Cursor simplified pricing to a unified request-based model, replacing previous complex tier structures.

title: Version 1.3.38-vscode: Config Fixes and Workspace Filtering
description: Continue v1.3.38-vscode includes config.yaml fixes, workspace directory filtering capabilities, and support for .continue/configs directory structure.

title: Version 0.56.0: Prompt Caching and Report Command
description: Aider v0.56.0 introduces prompt caching for Sonnet via OpenRouter for improved performance, new /report command for session summaries, and --chat-language switch for multi-language support.

title: Copilot CLI BYOK and Local Model Support
description: GitHub Copilot CLI now supports Bring Your Own Key (BYOK) and local model configurations, giving enterprises more control over their AI deployments.

title: Copilot Cloud Agent Validation Tools 20% Faster
description: Validation tools in Copilot's cloud agent have been optimized to run 20% faster, improving response times for code review and validation tasks.

title: Copilot CLI Activity in Usage Metrics
description: Copilot CLI usage is now included in organization usage metrics, providing better visibility into CLI-based AI assistant usage.

title: Version 0.120.0: Realtime V2 Background Agent Streaming
description: Codex CLI v0.120.0 (April 11, 2026) introduces Realtime V2 background agent streaming, custom TUI status lines, and code-mode tool declarations with MCP outputSchema support.

title: Version 1.9600.38: Adaptive Model for Dynamic Selection
description: Introduced Adaptive Model feature that dynamically selects the most appropriate AI model based on task complexity and context.

title: Version 1.9600.40: GPT-5.4 Mini Integration
description: Added GPT-5.4 mini model support for faster, more efficient code completion and generation tasks.

title: Version 1.9600.41: Adaptive Model Router
description: Windsurf 1.9600.41 introduces adaptive model router for intelligent task routing to optimal models, plus GPT-5.4 mini integration and various model updates.
